independence.uses: fresh raw OANDA Practice EUR_USD M5 bid/ask only

neuralNetwork.architecture: two independent 20 input -> 12 tanh hidden -> 1 sigmoid classifiers
neuralNetwork.label: separate probability that an executable long or short reaches +1.5R before -0.75R over the next 60 minutes
neuralNetwork.scoreModeSelection: three UTC entry windows and four predeclared quality rankings compared only on 2022-2024 training; selections locked before 2025 outcomes

execution.signalFrequency: one decision at the open of each selected UTC hour
execution.thresholdSelection: 2025 frequency only; binary search targeting 2.5 trades per OANDA market day; profitability not used

gates.development2025: n>=600, 2-3 trades/day, win rate>=40%, expectancy>0, PF>1, better-path accuracy>50.5%
